text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: tesseract-prod reserved-pool latency spike fired for tenant=tesseract (p95 > 1200ms) - incident runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/incidents/reserved-latency - PD: https://pd.company/INC12345
Mira Patel: ACKING. I'm oncall. grabbing logs and topology.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert acknowledged by Mira Patel (ack at 4128765440). Auto-escalation in 8m if not resolved.
Rajesh Kumar: seeing a sustained queue backlog on reserved-pool-12 (gpu-pool-a). p50 is fine, p95 and tail tokens are blowing up. likely KV cache thrash or CPU-side scheduling. grabbing agent traces.
Sam Ortiz: customer-facing note draft? Lila from CS is it fine to ping them once we have ETA?
Lila Chen (CS): pls wait for confirmation of mitigation. We'll pre-stage a short note: "We're investigating increased latency affecting a portion of your traffic; no data loss observed; updates in ~10m."
Mira Patel: quick check results: no node OOMs, but pod restart count up 2x in last 10m. kvcache hit-rate dropped from 0.92 -> 0.54.
Rajesh Kumar: confirming, KV cache eviction spike. Suggest two-step mitigation: 1) scale reserved-pool-12 by +2 replicas (hot path), 2) enable tiered-fallback-route to reserved-burst for non-urgent requests.
Mira Patel: ok executing scale.
Rajesh Kumar: run: ```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/reserved-pool-12 --replicas=6
# scale triggered at 4128765520
```
oncall-bot: Deployment scale submitted; autoscaler observed desired=6 (scaling event id: scale-4128765520).
Mira Patel: also toggling kvcache eviction-policy to 'LRU-extended' on reserved-pool-12 config to reduce churn. Patch: ```
PATCH /v1/config/pools/reserved-pool-12
{
  "kvcache": {"eviction": "lru-extended", "max_entries": 250000}
}
```
Rajesh Kumar: applied config change; monitors show kvcache hit-rate climbing (0.54 -> 0.68).
Sam Ortiz: drafting customer message: "We've increased capacity and adjusted cache policy; latency should improve within minutes. We'll update again in 15m or sooner." okay to send?
Lila Chen (CS): send now with note we may follow up with root cause. include link to status page.
Mira Patel: sent to tesseract SRE + account leads: "Action taken: scaled pool and adjusted cache policy. Monitoring improvement. Investigating underlying cause. —Mira" :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Metric alert resolved: reserved-pool-12 p95 latency back below threshold for 5m (alert auto-closed).
Rajesh Kumar: nice, p95 down to ~310ms now. tail still a bit higher but trending. We'll keep an eye for 30m.
Sam Ortiz: customer acknowledged, appreciated timely update.
Mira Patel: handing off to next oncall for observation. @Rajesh please watch the autoscaler logs for any oscillation. Leaving notes in incident channel.
Rajesh Kumar: will monitor. also opened a post-incident ticket to root cause: possible eviction storm from frequent small-model loads + cache pressure. ticket: INC-5678-RC.
Lila Chen (CS): logging RCA request and flagging for account manager follow-up.
oncall-bot: Incident closed by Mira Patel at 4128765760. PD incident INC12345 marked resolved.
Mira Patel: final note: mitigation worked; plan: add cache guardrails + look into model load patterns. low-severity customer impact. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
